EmailTemplate.subject: Register Now [Free Webinar]: "Making Working Remotely REALLY Work" with Ann M. Cohan of The Marvis Center (hosted by Chandler Hahn)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Lead.FirstName}, Join insurance Sales Coach, President and Founder of The Marvis Center Ann M. Cohan on Monday, March 30, 2020 @ 1:00 PM Eastern for a webinar on "Making Working Remotely REALLY Work." Ann’s coaching has helped countless agents be more successful (she has worked exclusively with the insurance industry since 2008). Her presentation will cover:
- How to keep your “game face on” and stay focused - How to keep connected to others in the office so you don’t lose the dynamics of TEAM - How Agents can “inspect what’s expected” without smothering the team members - How to stay motivated and committed day in and day out - How to keep production consistent, and so much more...
Ann’s presentation will also feature a team member who she’s been coaching for a number of years who has been successfully working remotely from home as a sales producer since she started with her Agent.
This is a “can’t miss” presentation specifically geared towards helping your agencies make working remotely really work! You can sign-up for the free webinar directly through our link here!
Best,
